evidence_quotes.quote: Per 60 ml (60 g) isotonic gel: 368 kJ / 87 kcal, Carbohydrate 22 g (of which sugars 0.6 g), Fat 0 g, Protein 0 g, Salt 0.01 g (~10 mg sodium).
Ingredients: Water, Maltodextrin (from Maize) (33%), Gelling Agents (Gellan Gum, Xanthan Gum), Natural Flavouring, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Preservatives, Sweetener (Acesulfame K).
Informed Sport certified; vegan and gluten-free.

adversarial_checks: Verified 60 g x 30 = 1800 g net weight (0.0% deviation) and 22 g / 60 g = 36.67% carb purity.
Verified Atwater calorie match: 4 * 22 g = 88 kcal vs 87 kcal declared (1.15% deviation <= 15%).
Confirmed single-source maltodextrin limitation (~60 g/hr SGLT1 ceiling) and Ace-K disclosure.
Confirmed zero legacy blocklist overlap and SM-05 factual compliance.
